newsitem.title: USA: Hearing delayed against ex-Texaco official.
newsitem.headline: Hearing delayed against ex-Texaco official.

text.p: A preliminary hearing for a former Texaco Inc executive charged with obstruction of justice in a racial discrimination case has been postponed again for 30 days, prosecutors said Thursday.
A spokesman for the Manhattan U.S. attorney's office said the government obtained the delay in the case against Richard Lundwall due to plea negotiations.
The government first notified the court of talks in December and has received previous postponements of the hearing that had been set most recently for Thursday.
Lundwall is the former senior coordinator of personnel services of the finance department at Texaco.
He had made secret tapes of meetings with other former executives as they discussed destroying evidence requested in a racial discrimination case against Texaco.
After Lundwall lost his job at Texaco, he turned the tapes over to the plaintiffs lawyers in the discrimination case.
Transcripts of the tapes were made public as part of the court record and Texaco has agreed to settle the suit for $176.1 million. The settlement requires court approval before becoming final.
